card.change: Refine scored parent attempt 4 by making one controlled feature-family ablation. Keep objective=binary, metric=AUC, equal row weights, 63 leaves, learning_rate=0.05, the 240-round ceiling, 30-round early stopping, the last-three-date chronological split, full-data refit at the selected round count, deterministic seeds, source-row restoration, and checkpoint-only final inference. Remove user_code, all video metadata, all video/author/music/tag target-rate tables, and all user-by-context/content target-rate tables. Train only on the exact parent subset derived from tab, is_rand, duration_ms, hourmin, and date: categorical tab/hour/weekday/daypart/duration buckets; capped log and square-root duration; zero, missing, 18-second, 60-second, and outlier flags; minute fraction; and cyclic hour/weekday terms. user_id is retained only to preserve the parent's training row sort and is never a model feature. The checkpoint contains only the booster, manifest, schema audit, and training diagnostics, eliminating aggregate-table transfer and checkpoint-size risks.
evidence: STATE:attempt 4 is the validation-best checkpoint with GAUC=0.5261195586343261, nDCG@5=0.5011200600226474, and primary=0.5136198093284867; it is the relevant parent and its checkpoint replay passed.

STATE:attempt 5 changed attempt 4 to per-user class-balanced weighting and fell to GAUC=0.4122374902743679, nDCG@5=0.3908344355907366, and primary=0.4015359629325522. That falsifies the weighting refinement, so this candidate restores attempt 4's unweighted binary loss and global chronological AUC selection.

STATE:attempt 4 improved both metrics over attempt 3's LambdaRank result, establishing unweighted all-row binary learning as the strongest measured objective; this experiment deliberately does not revisit the rejected ranking or weighted objectives.

EDA:validation-cold-item-rate reports that 0.7422197404 of validation rows contain videos unseen in training, while EDA:item-frequency-and-tail reports that 0.6706248142 of training videos are singletons. These measured shifts directly challenge attempt 4's video and high-cardinality content rate features.

Feedback:candidate-review-1788212895844887351 states that the warm-key coverage premise for author/music/tag transfer was unmeasured and pre-declares a duration/tab/time-only ablation first, followed by a no-metadata/no-user-context variant; this candidate performs that first ablation.

EDA:tab-context-distribution reports large stable label-rate differences across the dominant tabs (0.3194828108 for tab 1, 0.0395547152 for tab 0, and 0.4310815981 for tab 4), so tab remains a strong inference-available context feature.

EDA:duration-scale-and-outliers reports duration_ms from 0 to 10869724 with median 29866 and p99 486533, supporting the parent's fixed buckets, capped transforms, threshold flags, and outlier handling rather than an unscaled duration feature.

EDA:temporal-label-drift is non-monotone across training dates, supporting weekday/time-of-day features and the unchanged last-three-date chronological holdout rather than an absolute linear date trend.

STATE:attempt 1 established that evaluation_features lacks play_time_ms and same-row feedback, so the deterministic target rule remains unexecutable and all features here are confirmed pre-impression columns.
card.falsifier: Reject executability if predictions are not one finite float32 score per authoritative input row or if checkpoint-only final mode on the same label-free data_root fails to reproduce attempt predictions within controller tolerance. Reject the sparse-feature-overfit hypothesis if controller primary does not exceed attempt 4's 0.5136198093284867 by the campaign's frozen epsilon. If both GAUC and nDCG@5 are lower, retain attempt 4 and conclude that at least some removed personalized/content signal is useful; if the result is within epsilon, retain the earlier incumbent and use the ablation only as attribution evidence rather than claiming improvement.
card.hypothesis: Attempt 4 bundles stable row-local context with high-cardinality metadata and leave-one-out target-rate features whose serving distribution is substantially colder than their fitting distribution. Because 67.1% of training videos are singletons and 74.2% of validation rows contain unseen videos, those sparse features can consume tree capacity on patterns that disappear or collapse to prior values at inference. Holding the successful unweighted pointwise objective fixed while restricting the model to tab, duration, and calendar/time context should improve cold and temporal transfer if sparse target encodings are the incumbent's main source of overfit.
